verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents persistent browser sessions and reusable profiles, and its OpenAPI-generated API reference covers browser-session endpoints, so programmatic session management is its own documented capability. Nothing in the evidence documents running many sessions concurrently or any published concurrency limits; the mention of 'organization limits' is too vague to count as concurrency limits. missing for 10: documented concurrency limits, evidence of running a fleet of parallel sessions, details of session lifecycle endpoints (create/list/close), independent corroboration at scale
